items.title: Bob Kinkel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 31, 2012
items.q: Hugh Hartwell, who was the teacher for my freshman year when I took the electronic music course

ctx.x: So that was a help, the stuff you did here?

Oh yeah, it was very much. I did a lot of electronic music work here. They used to have a four-track Scully and a two-track Revox, and one of the big Arp modular synthesizers and I had a mini-Moog that I bought my senior year in high school, so I knew analog synthesis inside and out. And Hugh Hartwell, who was the teacher for my freshman year when I took the electronic music course, he goes, “if you learn how to edit tape you can always get a job in a recording studio.” And I got really, really good at editing…
